# Fourth

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P37](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

Fourth is characterized by her distinct hair arrangements, which have included innumerable plaits tied with white thread at the ends and wound around her head so that they stick out in all directions. Her hair has also been styled into two crinkly, plaited tails fastened with four bright blue ribbons. Additionally, she wears a white dress that is stiffly starched.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Fourth is a warm-hearted little handmaiden who shows genuine care for others. She is honestly worried about the condition of her adored mistress.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Fourth is a character who eventually married a [Yankee](../codex/factions.md#yankee) named Tom. Prior to this, she was not mentioned in the early events surrounding [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's journey to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's decision regarding Anne's future.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--fourth.md)

Fourth serves as a close acquaintance to [Anne](../character/anne.md), eventually assisting her at a wedding in Volume 2. Their connection dates back to an earlier journey to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounted her painful background as an orphan to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). This history of hardship stirred deep pity in [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and caused her to reconsider keeping [Anne](../character/anne.md).

- Friend of — close acquaintance and assistant at wedding (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--fourth.md)

Fourth maintains a close acquaintance with [Diana](../character/diana.md). Their friendship is demonstrated by Fourth's role as an assistant at a wedding in Volume 2 alongside her.

- Friend of — close acquaintance and assistant at wedding (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

Fourth enters into service under [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) beginning in Volume 2. In this capacity, Fourth acts as a subordinate to her.

- Serves under (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
